szoveg_eredeti:
Termi Protocol is live on Product Hunt again today. This one is built almost entirely from what you told us after the first launch.

The headline is the limit handoff. When an agent hits a usage, rate or context limit in the middle of a task, Termi saves the session (goal, changed files, commands, errors, open todos and the conversation) and hands it to an agent on another model, which continues from the last finished step. Nothing is sent until you confirm.

Eight days after launching Termi Protocol on Product Hunt, we have completed a major round of improvements based on early user feedback.

Termi is evolving into a visual workspace for managing AI coding agents, CLI development tools, agent memory, tasks, and multi-agent workflows from one place.

Your AI coding agent no longer loses all progress when it reaches a usage, rate, token, or context limit.

Weboldal: https://termiprotocol.com
